implement_trie_prefix_tree.optimal:
init:
    root = empty dict char -> child
insert(word):
    node = root
    for each ch in word:
        if ch not in node: node[ch] = empty dict   (create the missing link)
        node = node[ch]
    mark node with "$"   (a word ends at this node)
walk(text):
    node = root
    for each ch in text:
        if ch not in node: return nothing   (the path breaks)
        node = node[ch]
    return node
search(word):

kth_largest_element_in_an_array.optimal:
nums = copy of nums, target = n - k   (index of the answer in ascending order)
low = 0, high = n - 1
while low < high:
    pivot_index = partition(nums, low, high)
    if pivot_index == target: return nums[pivot_index]
    if pivot_index < target: low = pivot_index + 1   (the answer is among the bigger values)
    else: high = pivot_index - 1
return nums[low]
partition(nums, low, high):
    pick a random pivot_index, swap nums[pivot_index] with nums[high], pivot = nums[high]
    store = low
    for each i from low to high - 1:
        if nums[i] < pivot: swap nums[i] with nums[store], store = store + 1
    swap nums[store] with nums[high], return store   (the pivot lands at its final index)

task_scheduler.optimal:
counts = dict task -> count
heap = max-heap of the counts   (the root is the most frequent task)
cooling = empty deque of (ready_time, count)
time = 0
while heap or cooling is not empty:
    time = time + 1
    if heap is not empty:
        count = pop the largest count, minus 1   (run one copy)
        if count > 0: append (time + n, count) to cooling
    if the front of cooling has ready_time == time: pop it and push its count onto the heap
    if heap is empty and cooling is not: time = front ready_time - 1   (jump over the idle gap)

reorganize_string.optimal:
counts = dict letter -> count
heap = empty max-heap of (-count, letter)
for each ch in counts:
    if counts[ch] > (n + 1) / 2: return ""   (too many copies of one letter to keep apart)
    push (-counts[ch], ch)
out = empty list, held = none   (the letter just placed, kept out for one turn)
while heap is not empty:
    (neg_count, ch) = pop the most frequent, append ch to out
    if held exists and still has count left: push held back
    held = (neg_count + 1, ch)   (one copy spent)
return out joined

dfs(nums, used, path, result):

combination_sum.optimal:
candidates = sorted candidates, result = empty list
dfs(candidates, 0, target, empty path, result)
return result
dfs(candidates, start, remaining, path, result):
    if remaining == 0: append a copy of path to result, return
    for each i from start to n - 1:
        if candidates[i] > remaining: stop   (sorted, so the rest are too big too)
        push candidates[i] on path
        dfs(candidates, i, remaining - candidates[i], path, result)   (same i: reuse allowed)
        pop the top of path

generate_parentheses.optimal:
result = empty list
dfs(n, 0, 0, empty path, result)
return result
dfs(n, opened, closed, path, result):
    if size of path == 2n: append path joined to result, return
    if opened < n:
        push "(" on path, dfs(n, opened + 1, closed, path, result), pop the top of path
    if closed < opened:   (only close what is already open)
        push ")" on path, dfs(n, opened, closed + 1, path, result), pop the top of path
